remarks: Great Westport location walkable to train, beach, longshore. Amazing house with extra large front yard set far off Compo Rd South. This beauty offers privacy in a coveted Westport location. The long private tree-lined driveway offers a dramatic entrance to the home with a front yard large enough for a soccer game! The house has 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms with tremendous natural light. The master suite is on the 1st floor, with 3 additional bedrooms on the upper level. There is a great home office. Gorgeous hardwood floors throughout the home. A finished basement with a full bath that offers convenient guest space. Plus, a great sunroom in the back that allows for relaxation to sit and enjoy the mature landscaping. Open concept living with high ceilings. Location! Location! Location! This house is an A+ location near the beach. Move-in ready so you can be in Westport for the summer and be ready for the great schools in the fall. A must see for renting.
